chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to travel on Thursday and say: 'On it, deeds are ascended to God, and the ties of guardianship/friendship are fastened.'
ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet travel on Thursdays and what is the significance of that day regarding deeds and wilayah?
ai.summary: This tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Prophet’s (SAWW) specific practice of traveling on Thursdays, linking it to the ascension of deeds and the establishment of *Wilayah*. In Shia scholarship, this 'tying of Wilayah' is often interpreted as the confirmation or strengthening of the spiritual authority of the Imams, particularly Imam al-Rida (AS), on this day. It underscores the cosmic significance of Thursday in the Shia calendar as a day of divine connection and leadership affirmation.
